item.title: A prize or a dare for your challenge
item.summary: New challenges have one prize for the winner or one dare for the loser, with a duration from 3 to 365 days.
item.details: Tasks and stakes lock when both players agree. Accept before 8pm in your game time zone to start that day, unless a later start was chosen. Invite links show the stake and duration, and what the loser owes stays a prize or a dare. Ties and perfect games owe nothing.
